title: Nadella says 20% to 30% of Microsoft's code is written by AI
summary: In a fireside chat with Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg at Meta's LlamaCon conference, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella said that 20% to 30% of the code in the company's repositories was written by software, meaning AI, with more progress in Python and less in C++; Zuckerberg said he did not know how much of Meta's code is AI-generated. TechCrunch noted that Google CEO Sundar Pichai had said the week before that AI generates more than 30% of Google's code, that Microsoft CTO Kevin Scott expects 95% of all code to be AI-generated by 2030, and that it is unclear how Microsoft and Google measure AI-generated code.
